review.why: Builds dated competitor profiles from site scrapes, SEO data and reviews, keeping observed facts apart from inference.
review.summary: Takes competitor URLs and produces one profile each: positioning, features, pricing, customers, reviews and SEO, saved with the raw scrapes by date so snapshots can be compared. Observed facts, inferences and implications stay separate, and a missing feature is written as not observed, never as absent. Quick scan or deep profile.
strengths: Rules such as: never state a competitor's motive, never treat no pricing as free
Raw data saved by date for audits and diffs
Treats competitor pages as data, not instructions
cautions: Best results need Firecrawl and DataForSEO connectors, which are paid; a fallback uses plain page fetches
SEO traffic figures are provider estimates
Comparison pages and battle cards are left to sibling skills
